ModMetaData.name: Texture Lens
ModMetaData.author: Redbean
ModMetaData.description: 物品与角色贴图查看器。信息卡右上角按 T（或全局快捷键）打开高清查看窗：物品贴图按游戏真实材质渲染，颜色/遮罩与地图一致；角色立绘实时渲染，支持待机动作与征召时显示手中武器；透明悬浮预览窗支持 Ctrl+滚轮缩放内容；另支持朝向旋转、128~2048 多档尺寸与 PNG 导出（自动裁透明边）。需要 Harmony。\n\nHigh-resolution texture viewer for items and pawns. Press T on an info card (or use the hotkey) to open the viewer: item textures use the game's real materials; pawns render live with idle animation and equipped weapons; the transparent floating preview supports Ctrl+wheel zoom; also rotation, 128-2048 render sizes and PNG export. Requires Harmony.
